ev.q: is an American true crime documentary television series
revolving around Michelle McNamara as she writes a book about and investigates the Golden State Killer
is an American true crime documentary television series
the case of an elusive, violent predator
a heavy, but important tapestry of trauma, obsession, and survival
committing 50 home-invasion sexual assaults and ten murders
as well as a haunting personal memoir and self-examination
The original six-part series premiered on June 28, 2020
